statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. Let n = len(s). If there exist indices i, j with 0 <= i < j < n and s[i] = s[j], then r is the maximum of the set { j - i - 1 | 0 <= i < j < n and s[i] = s[j] }; otherwise r = -1. The substring between the two equal characters excludes the two endpoint characters, so adjacent equal characters give length 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 300 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail, panic, or overflow) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 300 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, -1 <= r <= len(s) - 2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 300 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r >= 0, there exist indices i and j such that 0 <= i < j < len(s), s[i] = s[j], and r = j - i - 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 300 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r >= 0, for every pair of indices i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(s) and s[i] = s[j], we have j - i - 1 <= r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 300 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = -1 if and only if there do not exist indices i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(s) and s[i] = s[j].
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 300 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 300, all bytes are lowercase letters, and there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(s)-1 and s[i] = s[i+1].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = len(s) - 2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 300, all bytes are lowercase letters, len(s) >= 2, and s[0] = s[len(s)-1].

statement: Whenever the function returns r on input s and returns r' on input rev(s), r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 300 and all bytes of s are lowercase letters. Let n = len(s) and let rev(s) be the slice of length n with rev(s)[i] = s[n-1-i] for every 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever the function returns r on input s and returns r' on input s', r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 300 and all bytes of s are lowercase letters. Let c be a byte with 97 <= c <= 122 such that c != s[i] for every 0 <= i < len(s), and len(s)+1 <= 300. Let s' be the slice of length len(s)+1 with s'[i] = s[i] for 0 <= i < len(s) and s'[len(s)] = c.

statement: Whenever the function returns r on input s and returns r' on input t, r = r'.
preconditions: s and t are slices satisfying 1 <= len(s) = len(t) <= 300 and all their bytes are lowercase letters, and for all i and j with 0 <= i < len(s) and 0 <= j < len(s), s[i] = s[j] if and only if t[i] = t[j].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r = -1, we have len(s) <= 26.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 300 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 97 <= s[i] <= 122.
